headline: Executive order encourages the U.S. Postal Service to favor American-made goods when it buys things.
what_it_does: This executive order, signed January 14, 2021, deals with "Buy American" policies for the U.S. Postal Service. Based on its title, it encourages the Postal Service to give preference to products made in the United States in its purchasing. The title says "encouraging," which suggests it urges the Postal Service to act rather than requiring it to. No summary was provided, so the specific details are not clear.

who_it_affects.how: The Postal Service is encouraged to adopt or strengthen policies that favor American-made goods in its purchasing.
Companies that make goods in the United States may have a better chance of selling to the Postal Service.
Companies selling foreign-made goods to the Postal Service may face less favorable treatment.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 14, 2021; executive orders usually take effect when signed, but no specific date was provided.
